takeaways.text: Lines up **Wide (outside)** on **71%** of 287 plays (n=204); also Slot 29% (n=83).
Runs a route on **100%** of dropbacks — about the WR average (100%). Effectively always a receiver; blocking is negligible.
On routes, averages **12.9 yd** downfield by the throw vs 11.2 for WRs (deeper) (n=287, snap→release window only).
Primary alignment is Wide (outside) (71%); a coach might set the first coverage answer to that spot. This is a hypothesis from observed tendencies, not a proven assignment.
